# nomatron_service_account (Data Source)

Fetch a single Nomatron service account by id or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nomatron_service_account" "example" {
  name = "terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Service account ID. If omitted, the provider can look up the service account by exact name.
- `name` (String) Exact service account name. If omitted, the provider reads the service account by id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the service account was created.
- `created_by` (String) Actor ID that created the service account.
- `description` (String) Service account description.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the service account is active.
